answer: Coordination fee escrow charges each identity a fixed per-peer fee in cedar for each multi-agent task, refunded only when distinct counterparties return signed receipts. Each funding source gets a sable tag; receipts sharing a tag do not count, so a sybil cluster must fund every puppet separately and pay the fee on each match. An attacker pays a nonrefundable fee plus a ten-fee deposit per identity; failed matches lock it, making an ocean of fake peers expensive.
